title: Review durable state and navigation delivery

rubric.text: Keeps current screen state distinct from pending navigation work and identifies loss across a collector gap with the current replay-zero SharedFlow
Explains why a one-consumer channel can lose a received event before successful handling and models pending work by ID until acknowledgement after handling
Accounts for multiple outstanding requests and the possibility of retry after successful handling but before acknowledgement, within the owner lifetime

provenance.normalization_note: Combined the documented StateFlow state contract with a synthetic single-consumer navigation seam.
